meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Reviewed role manifests and shared registry identity data, public contact tool schema and allowed role scope. Golden evaluation remains at its existing 33-check baseline.

auth.review_note: Reviewed hash-only credentials and patch writes. Blank credential inputs preserve existing values and canonical row bootstrap excludes a legacy unrecognized password.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed backend skill and commerce data contracts; read-only model-selected facts do not change payment, order, catalogue or checkout writes.

content.review_note: Reviewed Blog direct-route gating, sitemap module filtering, canonical URL and optional brand image defaults. Profile story is published as bounded plain paragraphs.

foundation.review_note: Rechecked shared configuration, row locking and optional contact rendering. The existing contact route is used for a form-only installation, with no new mutation or dependencies.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed Settings help and integrations boundaries. Profile identity and social metadata are separate from Google tags, credentials and reporting; no new OAuth permission is requested.

http-errors.review_note: Reviewed web and API dispatch. Module-off returns an intentional uncached 404; a settings transport failure still uses the guarded platform failure response.

interface.review_note: Reviewed profile editing, no-JavaScript save feedback, responsive Contact and About, desktop/mobile reference layout, and consistent app identity without a new frontend.

mail.review_note: Reviewed Contact admission and email operations. Published channels and hours remain separate from SMTP settings, recipients, enqueue, claims and delivery policy.

mcp-clients.review_note: The Settings help addition covers public profile fields. Reviewed isolated owner reporting grants, revocation and STDIO scope, which retain their existing behavior.

media.review_note: Reviewed persistent brand paths and owner upload contracts. The profile selects approved logo and favicon paths without modifying assets or media deletion and retention behavior.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed Public Site Profile labels, field limits and save feedback, independent mail configuration, and existing module controls against the native forms and validated two-site browser fixture.

public-mcp.review_note: Verified that a profile without published phone or email still has an actionable form link in the official MCP Apps client at both widths; the structured public facts remain optional.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed Shop route admission, existing capability and payment callbacks. Disabling Shop blocks new storefront checkout without changing payment completion or receipt access.

sales-channels.review_note: Confirmed the existing catalogue optimiser and filename handling remain the default. Only brand uploads retain the original raster type.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed deployment-owned configuration and upgrade guidance against native persistence and separate fixture installs, with browser checks added to existing CI and no installer.
